source.title: Natural Earth 1:10m rivers and lake centerlines

selection.purpose: Major-river gameplay layer for the Old World continental map; a curated selection rather than a complete drainage network.
selection.registration: WGS84 longitude/latitude registered to the original 8192x6144 Web Mercator heightmap, output zoom 6, centered at latitude 17.307970865257346 and longitude 70.31319074071382.
selection.method: Select exact Natural Earth name values listed in riverSystems plus the explicitly identified additionalSourceFeatures, retaining features with a line segment intersecting the map footprint. Preserve upstream feature order and all original coordinates and bounding boxes. The unnamed 598River receives a documented display label; append the documented reused authored Congo outlet extension. Do not otherwise clip, simplify, connect, or extend geometry.
selection.rationale: Keep major channels across Africa, Europe, Asia and Australia. Include differently named main-stem sections, lake/reservoir centerlines and named distributaries for continuity. Retain the Benue, Irtysh and Angara as major basin tributaries; exclude the dense minor-tributary network and canals.
knownLimitations: The northern crop excludes the Arctic mouths of the Ob, Yenisey and Lena; original linework crossing the crop is retained for the rasterizer to bound.
Natural Earth river linework can end at lake, estuary or coastline boundaries and contain small inter-feature gaps. No other approximate courses are authored to match this heightmap coastline.
Read-only four-neighbor QA of the initial bake found each selected river system internally connected at sizes 250, 500 and 1000; the Yangtze already reached mapped estuary water at all sizes.

Remaining mapped outlet gaps: Amur and Murray-Darling at sizes 500 and 1000; Dnieper at all sizes; Don at sizes 250 and 500. The Don reaches the enclosed Sea of Azov at size 1000, and the Nile reaches the enclosed Mediterranean at size 250; an unset ocean bit alone does not imply a river outlet gap.
The Congo outlet correction is explicitly approximate, reused from the existing Africa map rather than represented as unmodified Natural Earth data.

additionalSourceFeatures.reason: Original source delta branch closes the baked Ganges-Brahmaputra outlet gap at size 1000 without inventing geometry.

authoredFeatures.name: Congo
authoredFeatures.reason: Reuse the existing approximate Congo outlet extension to connect its inland Natural Earth endpoint to the Atlantic at sizes 500 and 1000. Preserve the existing authored geometry unchanged.

source.registrationUpdate: Reproject existing reviewed river geometries against replacement heightmap footprint.
